item.title: Enhancing bosonic qubit protection by squeezing
New monolithic ion trap opens quantum simulations to more researchers
item.description: Some quantum systems are so complex that even the most powerful supercomputers struggle to simulate their behavior. One solution is quantum simulation: building a controllable quantum system in the lab and tuning it to mimic the one researchers want to understand.

item.title: Quantum Simulation of Non-Markovian Open Quantum Systems via Low-Rank Kernel Compression and Coupling Dilution
item.description: arXiv:2610.29372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an error-controlled framework for the quantum simulation of non-Markovian open-system dynamics in Gaussian environments. item.title: Digital Quantum Simulation of Dynamics in Interacting Fields
item.description: arXiv:2610.28993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matter under extreme conditions behaves as a non-equilibrium, strongly-interacting quantum system. item.description: arXiv:2610.29050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Multi-Programming (QMP) enables the simultaneous execution of quantum circuits from multiple users on a single quantum chip in cloud quantum computing services.
